test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 18 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution: The correct answer is **"learners."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Learners"** means people who are acquiring knowledge or skills through study or experience. (जो अभी सीख रहा है या ज्ञान प्राप्‍त कर रहा है; शिक्षार्थी) • It is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank as the sentence refers to individuals who are gaining knowledge. • The word is a noun and is used to describe a person who is actively seeking to learn something. • **Example**: *They are **learners**__.* • So, the correct answer is Option 3. • Correct passage: The grammar concepts __are graded__ systematically and explained with examples __followed__ by exercises. The writing section __provides__ abundant practice in functional and imaginative writing with necessary scaffolding to __help__ learners. The listening and speaking sections have activities embedded in meaningful contexts that will encourage __**learners**__ to interact confidently in English. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **"People" **is a general term for individuals and does not specifically refer to those who are learning. (एक से अधिक व्‍यक्ति, लोग) • **"Leaders"** refers to individuals who guide or direct a group of people and is not relevant to the context of the sentence. (किसी काम का प्रबंधकर्ता या प्रभारी व्‍यक्ति, नेतृत्‍व-कर्ता) • **"Teachers"** refers to individuals who instruct others and while they may also be learners, it is not the best option to fill in the blank. (शिक्षक, अध्यापक, टीचर (विशेषतः स्‍कूल या कॉलेज में)) 1d4:Tc5f, The correct answer is **"astonishment."**
